skillRoutes.taskShape: Repository architecture, behavior, data flow, dependency, or change-impact analysis

agents.name: explore
agents.when: One bounded current-repository lookup materially improves the evidence

agents.name: critic
agents.when: A material reasoning dispute remains after the first evidence-backed conclusion

skillRoutes.result: Conclusion with evidence separated from inference and unresolved unknowns
skillRoutes.stop: The question is sufficiently answered from current evidence

skillRoutes.taskShape: Concrete bug, regression, repeated failure, or performance problem with an unknown cause
skillRoutes.authority: read-only unless repair is explicitly requested

agents.name: debugger
agents.when: The cause is unknown or the same failure repeats

agents.name: test-engineer
agents.when: A discriminating check or stable benchmark is missing

skillRoutes.result: Most likely cause, confidence, discriminating evidence, and remaining gaps
skillRoutes.stop: The requested diagnosis is sufficiently supported or the concrete evidence gap is identified

skillRoutes.taskShape: The user explicitly asks to be interviewed or to stress-test a plan through questions
skillRoutes.result: One decision-dependent question at a time and a concise final decision summary
skillRoutes.stop: The material decisions are resolved or the user stops the interview

skillRoutes.taskShape: The user requests a disposable runnable experiment for one uncertain product, logic, state, or UI question

agents.name: executor
agents.when: One independent bounded implementation slice materially improves throughput

agents.name: vision
agents.when: Reference-image or screenshot interpretation is necessary

skillRoutes.result: Runnable prototype, run command, observed answer, and keep-or-delete decision
skillRoutes.stop: The named prototype question is answered

skillRoutes.taskShape: The user explicitly requests test-first implementation

agents.name: test-engineer
agents.when: A material test-shape or regression-coverage risk remains

skillRoutes.result: Focused failing observation, passing observation, and remaining validation gaps
skillRoutes.stop: The requested behavior passes the focused regression check and refactoring preserves it

skillRoutes.taskShape: An exact source, artifact, runtime, deployment, or live/public delivery claim needs proof

agents.name: verifier
agents.when: The user or risk boundary requires an independent proof owner and the current owner is not already the verifier

agents.name: vision
agents.when: Visual evidence is indispensable to the delivery claim

skillRoutes.result: PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED for the exact requested boundary with identity-linked evidence
skillRoutes.stop: The claim is proved, disproved, or blocked by one concrete missing evidence boundary

skillRoutes.taskShape: A concrete UI state, transition, layout, or visual-runtime claim needs proof
skillRoutes.authority: read-only unless repair is explicitly requested

agents.name: vision
agents.when: Screenshot or image interpretation materially helps

skillRoutes.result: PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED with route, viewport, state, ownership, transition, and visual evidence
skillRoutes.stop: The named visual claim is proved, disproved, or concretely blocked

skillRoutes.taskShape: A concrete behavior or trust boundary needs a bounded hostile check
skillRoutes.authority: read-only or safe local checks within the exact authorization

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.when: An exact code or security candidate needs independent review

agents.name: test-engineer
agents.when: The existing harness cannot express the discriminating hostile check

agents.name: architect
agents.when: The material risk is a system or trust-boundary decision

skillRoutes.result: Verdicts for three to seven risk-relevant scenarios plus the normal-path baseline
skillRoutes.stop: Every selected risk has a verdict or one concrete blocker

skillRoutes.taskShape: The user explicitly requests reading or maintaining a repository-local Markdown wiki
skillRoutes.authority: read-only for lookup; exact requested wiki edits for maintenance

agents.name: writer
agents.when: A substantial evidence-grounded documentation rewrite materially benefits from a dedicated writing slice

skillRoutes.result: Requested wiki finding or exact durable documentation change
skillRoutes.stop: The requested wiki operation is complete; no automatic session capture follows

skillRoutes.taskShape: The user explicitly requests a context snapshot for another task or agent
skillRoutes.authority: write only the requested handoff artifact
skillRoutes.result: One evidence-linked context snapshot with authority boundaries, blockers, and next action
skillRoutes.stop: The handoff artifact is written and read back; no task is launched automatically

skillRoutes.taskShape: The user explicitly requests one check for repetition, reopened decisions, or drift from the current request
skillRoutes.authority: read-only using already available conversation evidence
skillRoutes.result: Direct finding and the smallest different authorized next action or concrete blocker
skillRoutes.stop: One bounded finding is returned without retry, state, delegation, or automatic continuation

agentCatalog.name: analyst
agentCatalog.useWhen: Requirements, acceptance criteria, or material ambiguity need read-only clarification
agentCatalog.avoid: General repository tracing or root-cause diagnosis
agentCatalog.returns: Implementable definition of done and material unresolved decisions

agentCatalog.name: architect
agentCatalog.useWhen: System boundaries, interfaces, ownership, or long-horizon tradeoffs are material

agentCatalog.name: code-reviewer
agentCatalog.useWhen: One exact non-trivial code or security candidate needs independent review
agentCatalog.avoid: Planning, implementation, or repeated review loops
agentCatalog.returns: Findings ordered by severity or explicit approval

agentCatalog.name: critic
agentCatalog.useWhen: A material plan, reasoning, operational, or rollback risk remains disputed
agentCatalog.avoid: Automatic second opinions or unchanged review repeats

agentCatalog.name: debugger
agentCatalog.useWhen: A concrete failure has an unknown root cause or repeats
agentCatalog.avoid: Known mechanical fixes without diagnostic uncertainty
agentCatalog.returns: Reproduction, root cause, and discriminating evidence

agentCatalog.name: dependency-expert
agentCatalog.useWhen: A package, SDK, framework, upgrade, replacement, or migration decision is required
agentCatalog.avoid: Usage documentation for an already chosen dependency
agentCatalog.returns: Compared options, compatibility risks, and recommendation

agentCatalog.name: executor
agentCatalog.useWhen: One genuinely independent bounded implementation slice materially improves throughput
agentCatalog.avoid: Trivial work, planning, or final ownership claims
agentCatalog.returns: Scoped changes, checks, and remaining risks

agentCatalog.name: explore
agentCatalog.useWhen: One bounded current-repository file, symbol, or relationship lookup saves owner time
agentCatalog.avoid: External research, implementation, or broad audit ownership
agentCatalog.returns: Current file and symbol map with references

agentCatalog.name: explore-luna
agentCatalog.useWhen: The primary explore model is unavailable, rate-limited, usage-limited, or inaccessible
agentCatalog.avoid: Routine preference or escalation from an unsatisfactory answer
agentCatalog.returns: The same bounded read-only lookup contract as explore

agentCatalog.name: git-master
agentCatalog.useWhen: The user explicitly authorizes a Git operation with materially complex history topology
agentCatalog.avoid: Routine status, diff, add, commit, or push work
agentCatalog.returns: Exact history evidence, performed operation, and before-and-after state

agentCatalog.name: planner
agentCatalog.useWhen: A bounded multi-step objective needs evidence-grounded sequencing and acceptance criteria
agentCatalog.avoid: Trivial work or a replacement planning workflow
agentCatalog.returns: Small executable plan with verification and stop conditions

agentCatalog.name: researcher
agentCatalog.useWhen: Current official behavior of an already chosen external technology needs primary-source evidence
agentCatalog.avoid: Dependency selection or repo-local implementation mapping
agentCatalog.returns: Version-aware primary-source findings and local consequence

agentCatalog.name: test-engineer
agentCatalog.useWhen: A non-trivial behavior lacks a reliable regression shape or stable benchmark
agentCatalog.avoid: Routine test volume or unrelated test cleanup
agentCatalog.returns: Smallest test strategy or runnable assertion

agentCatalog.name: verifier
agentCatalog.useWhen: A supplied completion or delivery claim requires independent validation
agentCatalog.avoid: Implementation, repair, or duplicate proof by the same owner
agentCatalog.returns: PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED with identity-linked evidence

agentCatalog.name: vision
agentCatalog.useWhen: Image, screenshot, or diagram interpretation is necessary
agentCatalog.avoid: Source-only review or general UI implementation
agentCatalog.returns: Bounded visual finding tied to acceptance

agentCatalog.name: writer
agentCatalog.useWhen: A substantial bounded documentation or user-guidance deliverable needs evidence-grounded writing
agentCatalog.avoid: Automatic notes, session capture, or undocumented product decisions
agentCatalog.returns: Exact requested documentation grounded in supplied sources
